$comment: One policy, read by the hooks module (mod/register.ts) and the shell bootstrap (sandbox/run.py). Paths starting ~/ are under the person's home. A container's children are projects; a project is governed when it has worktrees/main. `~/*` makes every folder in the home a container (~/Sites, ~/Tools, ~/OpenSource, ...). guardFiles are the guard's own files besides the plugin folder; nothing else outside a main worktree is protected.
